narr: A cold front in the vicinity of South FL and a series of mid-level impulses promoted instability and thus convection over the nearshore Atlantic waters off the Miami-Dade County coast and right along the coast due to coastal convergence. This combined with lingering moisture and slow storm motion allowed for heavy rainfall and flooding to occur across portions of Miami-Dade County.
ev: An off duty NWS meteorologist reported via social media and a phone call that flooding was ongoing at the intersection of SE 9th Avenue and SE 1st Street in downtown Miami. Video footage shows several inches of standing water on the roadway/curb as well as water entering the first floor of buildings. Water was halfway up car tires as well.
